correctness.rationale: Exact line-graph maximal clique characterization determines automorphism orbits. Degree and distance-to-colour-cell invariants separate every orbit for unequal endpoint leaf counts and equal counts at least three. The equal-two case has an explicit proof for ell=2,3,4,>=5; the ell=4 degree partition is equitable yet merges distinct triangle-membership orbits. Independent programs (2730 analytic-orbit cases and 63 rooted graph-isomorphism cases) corroborate all boundaries; finite tests are not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete all-order exceptional-parameter classification of a natural infinite, structurally decomposed line-graph family is mathematically substantive. It reveals a singular degree-equitable collision between triangle edges and an induced path pair, identifies the exact boundary of uniform orbit recovery, and resolves arbitrary spine lengths and branch multiplicities. It is not simply the already known smallest example or a routine finite-table increment.
